Chief_Complaint.content: Decreased hearing in the left ear

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Approximately 6 weeks of intermittent reduced hearing in the left ear

Intermittent mild dizziness and feeling off-balance
Dizziness is not described as room-spinning
Earlier felt a bit sick but later stated dizziness was not associated with nausea

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Brief hearing issue about one year ago lasting a few days

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient denies using Q-tips or cotton buds in the ears

Assessment.content: Left-sided hearing difficulty for 6 weeks with intermittent tinnitus and mild disequilibrium

Assessment.content: No otalgia, otorrhea, or fever associated with the left-sided hearing difficulty
